Step 1: Check quantity requirement of 1200 units from one supplier
- Alpha: max 1000 units < 1200 — fails quantity
- Bravo: max 1700 units ≥ 1200 — passes quantity
- Cobalt: max 2400 units ≥ 1200 — passes quantity

Step 2: Check delivery deadline of within 25 days
- Alpha: 24 days ≤ 25 — passes, but already failed quantity
- Bravo: 35 days > 25 — fails deadline
- Cobalt: 35 days > 25 — fails deadline

Step 3: Conclusion
No supplier meets both the quantity and deadline requirements, so no landed cost qualifies.
